conviction_note: Scaled number is abs_move 13% x (2*0.53-1) = +0.78: a slight upside lean from a management that has set guides it then beat (FY26 delivered $870.4m against a raised $857-860m guide), held near 50 because the lean runs against a 17.4-point put skew I cannot explain away; the findings sum to +1.5, larger than the scaled number because the skew and this name's habit of selling guided beats (-2.9% on the April revenue beat) sit in p_up rather than in the findings; abs_move is set above the 10.8% implied because the window holds both the print and the October 7 Investor Day, and the name's own median reaction is 16.5%.
bar: Q1 FY27 revenue $207-209m and adj. EBITDA ~$37m, company guide (Q4 FY26 call, https://s21.q4cdn.com/672210836/files/doc_financials/2026/q4/NEOG-USQ_Transcript_4Q26.pdf; release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000711377/000119312526324860/neog-ex99_1.htm). Consensus revenue $208.1m and EPS $0.04, whisper $0.06 (https://earningswhispers.com/article/NEOG/20293). The bar is sourced to a company guide, and consensus sits at its midpoint.
positioning_check: MarketBeat: 11.17m shares short, 5.14% of public float, 4.5 days to cover, settlement 2026-09-15, +5.5% month on month (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NEOG/short-interest). Not a crowded short. The sweep's 12.65% figure is an older or differently based snapshot. Baseline skew is +17.41 vol points (25d put over call), so downside is being paid for. Put/call OI is 0.66. The stock is -4.2% over 5 days and about 11% below the ~$13.76 it traded at after July (https://earningswhispers.com/article/NEOG/20293), and +2.6% over 20 days.

findings.finding: This management sets guides it then beats: FY26 revenue came in at $870.4m against a guide raised in April to $857-860m, Q4 revenue was $225.3m against a $212.35m consensus, and on the call the CEO said the guide reflects 'setting targets as we focus on restoring investor credibility'. Q1 revenue is therefore more likely to land at or above the top of the $207-209m guide than at its $208.1m midpoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (2026-04-09) beat on revenue with a raised FY revenue guide but gross margin fell, and the stock moved -2.9%. Q4 FY26 (2026-07-30) beat on revenue and EPS with an FY27 guide above consensus: +22.7%. Revenue beats have paid only when the guide or margin came with them.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the whisper ($0.06 against $0.04) already leans to a beat. If the beat-pattern were fully priced, the stock would not have given back about 11% from its post-July level into the print, and the skew would not be at +17 points.
findings.independence: The Q3 FY26 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/711377/000119312526148851/neog-ex99_1.htm) has the raised $857-860m guide that the year then beat. It is a different document, but the same management habit.

findings.finding: Neogen hosts an Investor Day on Wednesday 2026-10-07 at 9am ET (announced 2026-09-08), and moved this print from its usual bmo slot to amc the evening before. Q1 results and new multi-year targets (commercial, R&D, operational plans, the ~30% long-term EBITDA margin ambition) therefore land in the same window. The company chose to put the quarter directly in front of its strategy day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior investor day in the baseline. On the line it lands on, the July FY27 guide set above consensus with flat margins (a stated investment year) bought +22.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The date is public. What is not priced is the content: the targets are unseen. The option implied move (10.8% event, after netting ordinary volatility from a 12.9% straddle to 10/16) sits below the name's 16.5% median reaction although the window now holds two catalysts. If the event's size were priced, the straddle would sit closer to that history.
findings.independence: On the Q4 call management repeatedly deferred detail to 'our Investor Day this fall' (R&D licensing, PetriFilm SKUs, segment targets): https://s21.q4cdn.com/672210836/files/doc_financials/2026/q4/NEOG-USQ_Transcript_4Q26.pdf. The sign is mostly unknown. The small positive rests only on a management that has under-promised choosing to pair the quarter with this event.

findings.finding: The New World screwworm outbreak ran through Neogen's whole Q1 (June-August). There were 42 US cases by 2026-07-21, centred on Texas sheep and cattle. Neogen holds Section 2(ee) clearances for two Prozap topical products in Texas and Florida, and on the call management guided only a 'modest contribution in the first quarter'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Animal Safety swung from -8.7% core growth in Q3 FY26 to +0.5% in Q4. The stock's reactions (-2.9% and then +22.7%) tracked the overall guide rather than the segment.
findings.source_date: 2026-07 (case count as of the 2026-07-21 detection reported in the article)
findings.why_not_priced: Management called the contribution modest and said earlier outbreaks had limited scope, so the guide probably holds little of it. But case growth through July was known before the 07-30 guide, so this sits mostly inside the guide. Animal Safety is about 26% of revenue and Prozap is a small part of it, net of the 74% Food Safety business.
findings.independence: Neogen's own NWS product release (https://investors.neogen.com/news/news-details/2026/Neogen-Committed-to-Helping-Ranchers-Livestock-Producers-and-Horse-Owners-Fight-Against-New-World-Screwworm/default.aspx) and the transcript share the company as source. The case counts are independent (USDA via Fox: https://www.fox7austin.com/news/new-world-screwworm-cases-rise-32-texas-battles-outbreak).

findings.finding: bioMérieux, the largest listed food-safety microbiology peer, reported Industrial Applications up 7% organically in H1 2026 with acceleration in Q2, double-digit reagent growth and 1-2% price. That is consistent with the end-market recovery behind Neogen's 5.8% Food Safety core growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Food Safety core growth accelerating to 5.8% was the headline of the +22.7% July print.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it predates Neogen's July 30 guide, so management guided knowing this backdrop. It is filed as a proxy that points the same way as the company's own trend and does not contradict it.
findings.independence: On the Q4 call Neogen said food-producer volume growth turned positive in calendar Q1 2026 (transcript above). That is the company's own reading, not an independent series.

outside_window.finding: The Genomics sale to Zoetis ($160m, ~$140m net, aimed at deleveraging from 3.4x) is in an ACCC Phase 2 review that began around 2026-06-30 and can run up to 90 business days. The ACCC says the deal combines the two largest Australian cattle genomic-testing suppliers, so a determination near the company's 'end of 1H FY27' (2026-11-30) closing target is at risk of a remedy or delay. The call may restate the timeline; the regulatory outcome itself resolves later.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR since 2026-07-30: no 8-K beyond the 08-07 compensation item, no debt amendment, no pre-announcement. The 09-28 DEFA14A only corrects an ESPP share-reserve typo (1,000,000 to 6,000,000). Form 4s on 10-02 follow the 10-01 annual meeting.
Analyst actions since July: Piper Sandler upgraded to overweight with a $14 target (2026-08-26). Consensus is Hold at $12. Nothing new in the run-in.
Stock fell 4.5% on 2026-09-29 on below-average volume with no stated cause
ACCC Phase 2 determination date: not published in the sources reached; estimated as early November from the 90-business-day statutory limit
Screwworm case counts for August and September: no updated total found beyond the 2026-07-21 count of 42

rejected_candidates.candidate: Q1 FY27 is the lightest profit quarter (adj. EBITDA ~$37m, R&D +50%, global sales meeting costs)
rejected_candidates.detail: It is the same company guide that sets the bar in 'bar' and finding 1. Its margin side is already inside the $37m guide and the $0.04 consensus.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The sweep's 12.65% short-interest figure, which would make NEOG a crowded short
rejected_candidates.detail: MarketBeat's dated short-interest page shows 5.14% of float on settlement 2026-09-15; the 12%+ level is described there as a mid-2025 peak.

baseline_tension: My small positive lean cuts against the +17.4-point put skew and the 11% give-back from the post-July high. I cannot name why the option market is wrong about this print, so p_up sits at 53, not higher. The dual-catalyst window agrees with the baseline's large straddle and argues for a bigger absolute move than 10.8%.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6: the guide-beat finding lands inside a company-guided quarter on a name that sold an April revenue beat (-2.9%), so it was cut from +1.2 to +0.8.

Lesson 7: the positive sign runs against a +17.4 put skew with no stated reason the options are wrong, so the Investor Day finding was cut from +0.5 to +0.3 and p_up from 55 to 53. Short interest was checked (5.1% of float); there is no squeeze case to lean on.
Lesson 5: the bioMérieux proxy predates the company's own guide, so it sits inside it and was cut from +0.2 to +0.1. The screwworm proxy was already small and inside the guide, and was left at +0.3.
Lesson 6: the Genomics/ACCC item stays in outside_window, not in findings.
Lesson 8: no change. abs_move stays at 13, above the 10.8 implied and below the 16.5 history median, because two catalysts sit in one window.
